verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a hosted tax-calculation API (tax estimate, nexus, product categorization endpoints), which by nature means rate/rule logic lives server-side and calling clients never redeploy for tax-table changes — this is implied by the architecture (kintsugi-docs-9, kintsugi-docs-8, kintsugi-docs-11). However, there is no explicit documentation of a rate/rule update cadence, changelog, or notification mechanism confirming when jurisdictional changes 'take effect.' Missing for 10: explicit changelog or release notes for rate/rule changes, documented update cadence, and confirmation that no customer action is ever required when rules change.
